BEGIN

DECLARE h funding_wallet_heads;n numeric;lo bigint;hi bigint; BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO h FROM funding_wallet_heads WHERE tenant_id=t;SELECT count(*)::numeric,min(seq),max(seq) INTO n,lo,hi FROM funding_wallet_operations WHERE tenant_id=t;
 IF h.tenant_id IS NULL OR n<>h.tail_seq::numeric+1 OR lo<>0 OR hi<>h.tail_seq
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funding_wallet_operations o WHERE (o.tenant_id,o.epoch_id,o.seq,o.id)=(t,h.epoch_id,hi,h.tail_operation_id))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funding_wallet_operations o LEFT JOIN funding_wallet_operations p ON p.id=o.previous_id WHERE o.tenant_id=t AND o.seq>0 AND (p.id IS NULL OR p.tenant_id<>t OR p.epoch_id<>o.epoch_id OR p.seq<>o.previous_seq OR p.seq::numeric<>o.seq::numeric-1))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'funding_lot_wallet_prefix' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

DECLARE s settlements;v reservations;j journals; BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT s FROM settlements WHERE id=sid;SELECT * INTO STRICT v FROM reservations WHERE request_id=s.request_id;SELECT * INTO STRICT j FROM journals WHERE id=s.journal_id;
 IF s.tenant_id<>v.tenant_id OR s.charged_amount>v.amount OR s.refunded_amount::numeric<>coalesce((SELECT sum(f.amount::numeric) FROM refund_orders f WHERE f.settlement_id=s.id AND f.state='approved'),0)
 OR v.status<>s.status OR (j.tenant_id,j.operation_id,j.kind,j.reference,j.actor,j.currency) IS DISTINCT FROM (s.tenant_id,s.id,s.status,s.request_id,'system','CNY')
 OR NOT fl_journal_lines(j.id,s.tenant_id,v.amount::numeric-s.charged_amount::numeric,-v.amount::numeric,s.charged_amount::numeric,s.charged_amount>0)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM request_records r WHERE r.id=s.request_id AND r.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND r.billing_status=s.status)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projection_outbox o WHERE o.operation_id=s.id AND o.kind=s.status AND o.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND o.schema_version=1 AND o.sanitized_payload=jsonb_build_object('amount',s.charged_amount::text,'released',(v.amount::numeric-s.charged_amount::numeric)::text,'request_id',s.request_id))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audit_events a WHERE a.action='billing.'||s.status AND a.target=s.id AND a.actor='system' AND a.tenant_scope=s.tenant_id AND a.request_id=s.request_id AND a.sanitized_diff=jsonb_build_object('amount',s.charged_amount::text,'reason',s.reason))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'funding_lot_finish_source' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN (s.tenant_id,j.id,j.operation_id,s.charged_amount,v.amount::numeric-s.charged_amount::numeric,-v.amount::numeric,s.charged_amount::numeric,0,NULL,NULL)::fl_source_proof;
END

DECLARE o funding_wallet_operations;f refund_orders; BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT o FROM funding_wallet_operations WHERE id=oid;SELECT * INTO STRICT f FROM refund_orders WHERE id=o.source_id AND state='approved';
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funding_lot_legacy_settlements WHERE settlement_id=f.settlement_id AND tenant_id=f.tenant_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM funding_lot_legacy_approved_refunds WHERE refund_order_id=f.id)
 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM funding_lots WHERE legacy_refund_order_id=f.id)<>1 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM funding_consumption_refund_lots WHERE refund_order_id=f.id)<>1
 OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM funding_lots l JOIN funding_consumption_refund_lots r ON r.lot_id=l.id JOIN funding_lot_events e ON e.lot_id=l.id AND e.wallet_operation_id=o.id
  WHERE l.legacy_refund_order_id=f.id AND l.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND l.origin_kind='legacy_consumption_refund' AND l.issued_amount=f.amount AND l.refund_class='nonrefundable' AND l.fifo_at=o.created_at
  AND r.refund_order_id=f.id AND r.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND r.origin='legacy_settlement' AND r.settlement_lot_id IS NULL AND r.allocation_index=1 AND r.amount=f.amount
  AND e.kind='legacy_consumption_refund' AND e.before_revision=0 AND e.before_available=0 AND e.before_held=0 AND e.before_consumed=0 AND e.available_delta=f.amount::numeric AND e.inference_held_delta=0 AND e.consumed_delta=0 AND e.issued_delta=f.amount::numeric
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'funding_lot_legacy_refund' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

DECLARE o funding_wallet_operations;v reservations; BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT o FROM funding_wallet_operations WHERE id=oid;SELECT * INTO STRICT v FROM reservations WHERE id=o.source_id;
 IF EXISTS(
  WITH before_lots AS (
   SELECT l.id,l.fifo_at,coalesce(sum(e.available_delta) FILTER(WHERE op.seq<o.seq),0) a FROM funding_lots l LEFT JOIN funding_lot_events e ON e.lot_id=l.id LEFT JOIN funding_wallet_operations op ON op.id=e.wallet_operation_id
   WHERE l.tenant_id=o.tenant_id GROUP BY l.id,l.fifo_at
  ),candidates AS (SELECT *,coalesce(sum(a) OVER(ORDER BY fifo_at,id COLLATE "C" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior FROM before_lots WHERE a>0),
  expected0 AS (SELECT *,greatest(least(a,v.amount::numeric-prior),0) q FROM candidates),
  expected AS (SELECT id,q,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY fifo_at,id COLLATE "C") idx FROM expected0 WHERE q>0),
  actual AS (SELECT * FROM funding_reservation_lots WHERE reservation_id=v.id)
  SELECT 1 FROM expected x FULL JOIN actual a ON a.lot_id=x.id WHERE x.id IS NULL OR a.id IS NULL OR a.tenant_id<>o.tenant_id OR a.amount::numeric<>x.q OR a.allocation_index<>x.idx
 ) OR (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount::numeric),0) FROM funding_reservation_lots WHERE reservation_id=v.id)<>v.amount::numeric
 OR EXISTS(
  WITH xs AS (SELECT * FROM funding_reservation_lots WHERE reservation_id=v.id),es AS (SELECT * FROM funding_lot_events WHERE wallet_operation_id=o.id)
  SELECT 1 FROM xs FULL JOIN es ON es.lot_id=xs.lot_id WHERE xs.id IS NULL OR es.id IS NULL OR es.kind<>'reserve' OR es.available_delta<>-xs.amount::numeric OR es.inference_held_delta<>xs.amount::numeric OR es.consumed_delta<>0 OR es.issued_delta<>0
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'funding_lot_fifo_allocation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
END

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_captures c JOIN payment_orders o ON o.id=c.order_id JOIN payment_order_capture_selections s ON s.order_id=o.id
 JOIN payment_transaction_identities i ON i.id=s.identity_id JOIN payment_verified_evidence e ON e.id=c.verified_evidence_id
 WHERE c.id=capture_ref AND payment_identity_valid(i.id) AND payment_capture_evidence_valid(e.id) AND payment_capture_evidence_valid(s.first_evidence_id) AND c.identity_id=i.id
 AND (c.tenant_id,c.environment_id,c.merchant_id,c.provider_transaction_id,c.amount,c.wallet_credit_amount,c.currency,c.captured_at,c.provider_order_revision)
  =(i.tenant_id,i.environment_id,i.merchant_id,i.provider_transaction_id,i.amount,o.wallet_credit_amount,i.currency,i.captured_at,i.provider_order_revision)
 AND e.kind='capture' AND (e.environment_id,e.merchant_id,e.order_id,e.provider_transaction_id,e.amount,e.currency,e.happened_at,e.provider_order_revision)
  =(i.environment_id,i.merchant_id,i.order_id,i.provider_transaction_id,i.amount,i.currency,i.captured_at,i.provider_order_revision)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_verified_evidence first WHERE first.id=s.first_evidence_id
  AND (first.environment_id,first.merchant_id,first.order_id,first.provider_transaction_id,first.amount,first.currency,first.happened_at,first.provider_order_revision)
   =(i.environment_id,i.merchant_id,i.order_id,i.provider_transaction_id,i.amount,i.currency,i.captured_at,i.provider_order_revision))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_review_facts v WHERE v.selection_order_id=s.order_id AND v.reason='funding_amount_overflow'))

 JOIN payment_verified_evidence e ON e.id=i.evidence_id JOIN payment_provider_revisions r ON (r.environment_id,r.merchant_id,r.order_id,r.provider_order_revision)=(i.environment_id,i.merchant_id,i.order_id,i.provider_order_revision)
 WHERE i.id=identity_ref AND payment_capture_evidence_valid(e.id) AND e.kind='capture' AND (i.environment_id,i.merchant_id,i.order_id,i.tenant_id,i.amount,i.currency)=(o.environment_id,o.merchant_id,o.id,o.tenant_id,o.amount,o.currency)
 AND (i.environment_id,i.merchant_id,i.order_id,i.provider_transaction_id,i.amount,i.currency,i.captured_at,i.provider_order_revision)=(e.environment_id,e.merchant_id,e.order_id,e.provider_transaction_id,e.amount,e.currency,e.happened_at,e.provider_order_revision)
 AND r.kind='capture' AND r.fact_digest=e.fact_digest AND i.captured_at>=o.created_at AND i.captured_at<o.expires_at
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_provider_revisions closed JOIN payment_verified_evidence ce ON ce.id=closed.evidence_id WHERE closed.order_id=o.id AND closed.kind='closed' AND (i.captured_at>=ce.happened_at OR i.provider_order_revision>=closed.provider_order_revision)))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM journals j JOIN funding_receipts f ON f.journal_id=j.id
 LEFT JOIN credit_orders c ON f.source_kind='manual_credit' AND c.id=f.source_id
 LEFT JOIN vouchers v ON f.source_kind='voucher_grant' AND v.id=f.source_id
 LEFT JOIN voucher_batches b ON b.id=v.batch_id
 LEFT JOIN voucher_redemptions r ON r.voucher_id=v.id AND r.funding_receipt_id=f.id
 LEFT JOIN commerce_commands cmd ON cmd.operation_id=r.operation_id
 LEFT JOIN commerce_operation_receipts terminal ON terminal.operation_id=r.operation_id
 WHERE j.id=journal_ref AND j.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND j.currency='CNY' AND f.currency='CNY' AND f.amount>0
 AND ((f.source_kind='manual_credit' AND c.state='approved' AND c.journal_id=j.id AND c.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND c.amount=f.amount AND c.approver<>c.requester AND j.kind='credit' AND j.operation_id=c.id AND j.reference=c.id AND j.actor=c.approver)
 OR (f.source_kind='voucher_grant' AND b.state IN ('active','revoked') AND r.id=j.operation_id AND j.kind='voucher_grant' AND j.reference=v.id AND j.actor=r.actor
  AND r.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND r.journal_id=j.id AND r.amount=f.amount AND b.face_amount=f.amount AND r.batch_id=b.id
  AND r.created_at>=b.activated_at AND r.created_at<b.expires_at AND (b.terminal_at IS NULL OR r.created_at<=b.terminal_at)
  AND cmd.kind='voucher.redeem' AND cmd.actor=r.actor AND cmd.scope='tenant:'||r.tenant_id
  AND terminal.status='accepted' AND terminal.reason='accepted' AND terminal.resource_id=r.id AND terminal.amount=f.amount AND terminal.funding_receipt_id=f.id AND terminal.journal_id=j.id))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_commands c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT mock_json(body) j) x
 WHERE c.command_id=cid AND mock_reply_valid(x.j,false) AND x.j->>'command_id'=c.command_id AND x.j->>'merchant_order_id'=c.merchant_order_id AND x.j->>'command_kind'=c.kind AND x.j->>'parameter_digest'=c.parameter_digest
 AND (NOT final OR x.j->>'command_state'='completed'))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_commands c JOIN mock_orders o USING(merchant_order_id)
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT mock_json(body)->'result' r,mock_json(c.canonical_parameters) p) x
 WHERE c.command_id=cid AND CASE x.r->>'status'
 WHEN 'ready' THEN c.kind='checkout' AND revision=1 AND o.amount=(x.p->>'amount')::bigint AND o.currency=x.p->>'currency' AND o.created_at=(x.p->>'created_at')::timestamptz AND o.expires_at=(x.p->>'expires_at')::timestamptz AND o.checkout_ref=x.r->>'checkout_ref'
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_order_transitions t WHERE t.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND t.revision=1 AND t.kind='ready' AND t.command_id=c.command_id)
 WHEN 'closed' THEN c.kind='cancel' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_order_transitions t WHERE t.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND t.revision=revision AND t.kind='closed' AND t.occurred_at=(x.r->>'closed_at')::timestamptz)
 WHEN 'captured' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_captures a WHERE a.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND a.provider_order_revision=revision AND a.provider_transaction_id=x.r->'capture'->>'provider_transaction_id' AND a.amount=(x.r->'capture'->>'amount')::bigint AND a.currency=x.r->'capture'->>'currency' AND a.occurred_at=(x.r->'capture'->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz)
 WHEN 'rejected' THEN c.kind='checkout' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_order_transitions t WHERE t.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND t.revision=revision AND
  ((x.r->>'failure_code'='order_closed' AND t.kind='closed') OR (x.r->>'failure_code'='checkout_rejected' AND t.kind IN ('ready','captured')) OR
   (x.r->>'failure_code'='order_expired' AND t.kind='closed' AND t.command_id=c.command_id AND o.amount=(x.p->>'amount')::bigint AND o.created_at=(x.p->>'created_at')::timestamptz AND o.expires_at=(x.p->>'expires_at')::timestamptz)))
 ELSE false END)

 AND mock_json(n.canonical_body)->>'provider_transaction_id'=c.provider_transaction_id AND mock_json(n.canonical_body)->>'amount'=c.amount::text AND mock_json(n.canonical_body)->>'currency'=c.currency

 WHERE c.command_id=cid AND mock_command_matches(c.command_id,c.initial_reply,false)
 AND ((p.state='held' AND r.command_id IS NULL AND p.held_by_control_id IS NOT NULL AND mock_json(c.initial_reply)->>'command_state'='in_progress') OR
 (p.state='completed' AND r.command_id IS NOT NULL AND mock_command_matches(c.command_id,r.result_body,true) AND mock_json(r.result_body)->>'provider_order_revision'=r.provider_order_revision::text AND r.completed_at=p.completed_at AND mock_result_effect(cid,r.result_body,r.provider_order_revision)
 AND ((mock_json(c.initial_reply)->>'command_state'='completed' AND c.initial_reply=r.result_body AND p.held_by_control_id IS NULL AND p.released_by_control_id IS NULL) OR
 (mock_json(c.initial_reply)->>'command_state'='in_progress' AND p.held_by_control_id IS NOT NULL AND p.released_by_control_id IS NOT NULL)))))

 (SELECT count(*) FROM mock_delivery_attempts a WHERE a.event_id=eid)=d.attempt_count AND
 (d.attempt_count=0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_delivery_attempts a WHERE a.event_id=eid AND a.generation=d.generation AND a.attempt_no=d.attempt_count AND (d.state<>'leased' OR a.lease_until=d.lease_until))) AND
 (d.state<>'delivered' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_delivery_observations x WHERE x.event_id=eid AND x.generation=d.generation AND x.outcome='ack')) AND

 (d.state<>'review_required' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_delivery_attempts a WHERE a.event_id=eid AND a.generation=d.generation AND
  (a.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_delivery_observations x WHERE x.event_id=eid AND x.generation=d.generation AND x.outcome='failed')))))

 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_order_transitions t WHERE t.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND t.revision=1 AND t.kind IN ('ready','closed')) AND
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_order_transitions t WHERE t.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND t.revision=o.revision AND t.kind=o.state AND (o.state<>'closed' OR t.occurred_at=o.closed_at)) AND
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_order_transitions t WHERE t.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND (t.revision>o.revision OR
  (t.kind='ready' AND (t.revision<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_commands c JOIN mock_command_results r USING(command_id) WHERE c.command_id=t.command_id AND c.kind='checkout' AND c.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND mock_json(r.result_body)->'result'->>'status'='ready' AND r.provider_order_revision=t.revision))) OR
  (t.kind='closed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_commands c JOIN mock_command_results r USING(command_id) WHERE c.command_id=t.command_id AND c.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND r.provider_order_revision=t.revision AND
   ((c.kind='cancel' AND mock_json(r.result_body)->'result'->>'status'='closed') OR (c.kind='checkout' AND mock_json(r.result_body)->'result'->>'failure_code'='order_expired')))) OR
  (t.kind='captured' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_captures c WHERE c.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND c.provider_order_revision=t.revision AND c.control_operation_id=t.control_operation_id AND c.occurred_at=t.occurred_at)))) AND
 ((o.state='captured' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_captures c WHERE c.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id AND c.amount=o.amount AND c.currency=o.currency AND c.provider_order_revision=o.revision AND c.occurred_at>=o.created_at AND c.occurred_at<o.expires_at)) OR
 (o.state<>'captured' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mock_captures c WHERE c.merchant_order_id=o.merchant_order_id))))
